mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 10.0%, it signals a severe labor market downturn that triggers central bank intervention and fiscal stimulus, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a severe contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a policy response that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (i.e., when both series decline, SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 85.0 indicates a second dip in economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 85.0 during the post-recession recovery phase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in residential construction (HOUST) below 550.0 thousand units signals weak housing market conditions, which typically precede negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals an overheating economy that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a severe economic downturn with accommodative policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE > 9.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases (i.e., SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of such instances).

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime, a contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 100% of the previous quarter's level signals a deepening recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 contracts (quarterly) during a recession.
